Failed DKIM signature and DMARC check for micros0ft-support.com

WAF alert on POST /submit containing credential-like patterns
User agent typical of corporate environment but connecting to suspicious domain
Newly registered domain with privacy-protected WHOIS
examples.detection_method: Deploy advanced email filtering with DKIM/DMARC/SPF validation rejecting emails failing auth checks. Use sandbox and heuristic analysis to detect phishing URLs with homograph domains. Monitor web server logs and WAF alerts for unusual POST requests carrying credential parameters. Perform DNS query monitoring for suspicious new domains and unusual client queries. Conduct user training and phishing simulations to increase user awareness.
